infobox.usage: Unlocks the home cinema room in apartment 8 on the third floor of the Concordia building on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Concordia apartment 8 home cinema key (Cinema) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the home cinema in apartment 8 in the Concordia building.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Drawers
- In Jackets
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text:
Home cinema door in apartment 8 on the third floor of the Concordia building at Streets of Tarkov.

It is also possible to reach the room through a breakthrough from apartment 34.
